title: Qualification, tests and known blockers
summary: LOCAL_PASS of native ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 synthetic model and admission checks does not imply a Paphos field localisation. The 2023 index was a separate read-only run. No original media plus ADS-B paired ridge matches have yet been observed by this prototype.
invariants: Physics tests: 3D range, radial speed, retarded arrival and approach/recession frequency shift.
Geometric track tests: 7 synthetic trajectory predictions, positive/negative Doppler and monotone received times.
Negative tests reject duplicate sample time, non-causal radial velocity and nonpositive speed of sound.
Synthetic nearest-point CPA from sampled paths is not sub-sample CPA or resolved flight-source identity.
Versioned Git submission without Autobuilder PASS receipt is SOURCE_PRESENT/LOCAL_PASS, not autobuild or field acceptance.
procedure: Run sh run_tests.sh from the source package on ooRexx r13196.
On a field dataset, align sample-exact original Ogg/MP4 PTS clocks before acoustic scoring.
Use held-out audio intervals and competing hypotheses; preserve null and rejected matches.
Only promote to FIELD_PASS with source-pinned observations, uncertainty and independent held-out validation.
